joint_source: /dev/FXDcss read-only controller measured feedback; 14 arm joint angles, speed, torque; target sampling 100 Hz

joint_units.record/actions.jsonl: SDK-accepted targets; distinct from measured state

physical_accuracy: No external joint-angle/zero-offset calibration evidence; cannot certify absolute mechanical angular error.
sync: Controller monotonic frame completion time versus shared-state read midpoint; camera triplets matched within 25ms, nearest actual joint sample; no exposure/hardware synchronization or calibrated sensor-to-host delay.
confirmed_quality_issues: New ZED configuration has no formal motion episode in the local episode directory; preview-only validation cannot certify training datasets.
720p30 three-camera preview logs show native queue drops (249/239/239 in reviewed stream), approximately 25 fps delivery; nominal settings are not guaranteed actual rates.
Original-size JPEG encode path uses Pillow verify without full decode. A saved corrupt wrist sample was accepted by this path but failed full load.
complete=true and data_validate=false can coexist; Tianji upload gating does not require data_validate or quality_passed.
Camera exposure delay, joint-feedback producer delay, gripper transport delay and cross-camera physical timing have not been measured.
Action attachment uses nearest time within 150ms and can select a future command; this is not a last-known-command causal policy.
Upload metadata carries nominal per-camera FPS and original timestamps; downstream variable-rate synchronized playback is not verified.
changes_made: Read-only audit and isolated temporary reproduction; no collection or upload initiated.
